scenarios.mission: Approach the woman seated on the sofa, avoiding floor objects; stop at a comfortable distance.
Travel from the living area into the kitchen, avoiding the cushion, stroller and furniture; stop before the cabinets.
Leave the kitchen and move through the dining area toward the sofa, slowing for the toy, chair legs and people.
Find the bedroom through the hallway. Keep clear of doorframes, furniture and the bed.
Inspect the route from the lit living room toward a dark bedroom. Slow down as visibility falls and stop if the route cannot be established.
Observe from the dark room. Yield and remain still when a person approaches through the lit doorway.

full_reference.provenance_note: Offline batch-authored ASTRA reference review of 180 real frames and supplied history; not 180 independent online model calls. full_reference.provenance_note: Offline batch-authored ASTRA reference review of 180 real frames and supplied history; not 180 independent online model calls. No candidate/API runs, latency measurements, or audio listening were performed. Per-time judgments exclude future commands and future observations.
full_reference.review_method: Actual image inspection in episode contact sheets; available prefix images also inspected. Per-time judgment uses current frame and supplied memory.before only; after and authored markers are data-audit inputs, not future evidence.

A.input_basis: No recorded command completes in [t,t+1). Missing-recording text is never an audio oracle.
critical_errors: Inventing an audible command in a no-completed-speech bucket.

accepted_alternatives: Equivalent object names and concise paraphrases with the same spatial relationships.

full_reference.provenance_note: Offline batch-authored ASTRA reference review of 180 real frames and supplied history; not 180 independent online model calls.
